selection.rule: arms passing G1-G9 + AT + B1 + B2 + F3 and their plateau neighbours' AT; selected = highest after-tax liquidated CAGR at $100k on the 2000 window

gates.AT: after-tax CAGR > R2 in all three windows at $100k
gates.F3: share of the 21 instruments with delta max DD <= +3.0 pp >= 80%
gates.P: the selected arm's neighbours each pass AT
gates.pre: ewma_band_v1 G1-G9 (G7 = six OOS windows, G8 = pooled M1-M5 bootstrap)

params.instrument: synthetic QLD* daily-reset 2x on QQQ total return, expense 0.95%/yr, financing DTB3 + {base 0.0, calibrated 0.75%/yr}
params.signals: production R2 (equity_leveraged_trend_v1 1.2.0): E2 2-of-3 on price closes (SMA200, 252-session price return > 0, close > 126-session max/min midpoint) + early re-entry at 0.5 x vt while E2 off and close > SMA50, vol20 < its 252-session median and close > close 20 sessions ago; exit early below SMA50
params.sizing: vt = min(1, 0.35/vol20) on synthetic QLD*, cap 0.98
